prompt:
GAME FLOOR OBJECT SPRITE. Seen straight from above, like a mat lying flat on the ground in a top-down strategy game, filling a square.

Create an ORIGINAL game sprite for a helicopter cargo net spread flat and empty on the ground, ready to be filled and lifted. Images 1 and 2 are our approved items from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only; image 1 also shows the look of our lifting webbing and steel rings. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Draw ONLY the net, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 90 percent of the square canvas.

A square net of thick olive-drab woven webbing straps crossing in a coarse diamond grid, with gaps of plain white background between the straps. A heavier border strap runs round all four edges, and at each corner a short strap leads to a small dull steel ring; the four rings lie just inside the corners.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every strap, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones, muted olive and steel colours, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, cargo, boxes, people, ground, grass or shadow outside the net.
